headline: Donald Trump looks forward to meeting PM Tarique Rahman
summary: The US President-elect has expressed his desire to meet the Prime Minister of Bangladesh, thanking him for the purchase of Boeing aircraft.
details: US President-elect Donald Trump has expressed his expectation to meet with Prime Minister Tarique Rahman soon.
In a letter sent to the Prime Minister, Trump thanked the Bangladeshi leader for the purchase of Boeing aircraft, stating that 'Boeing will not let you down, and I will not forget'.
The communication highlights a positive diplomatic shift and a focus on economic cooperation between the United States and Bangladesh.
The meeting, if scheduled, is expected to focus on bilateral relations, trade, and strategic partnerships between the two nations.

headline_marked: End of an era: [[Messi retires from Argentina national team]], leaving No. 10 vacant
headline: End of an era: Messi retires from Argentina national team, leaving No. 10 vacant
summary: The football legend brings an extraordinary international career to a close, sparking debate over who will inherit his iconic jersey and influence.
details: Lionel Messi has officially announced his retirement from the Argentina national team, ending a legendary international career that saw him lead the Albiceleste to World Cup, Copa America, and Finalissima glory.
A major point of discussion is now the fate of the iconic No. 10 jersey, which Messi first wore on March 28, 2009, in a 4-0 victory over Venezuela under coach Diego Maradona.
Several players have worn the shirt in Messi's absence, including Franco Mastantuono in a recent 2026 World Cup qualifier against Ecuador, as well as Angel Correa and Paulo Dybala.
Potential long-term candidates for the shirt include Lautaro Martinez, who wears No. 10 for Inter, and Alexis Mac Allister, who has worn it for Liverpool.
Other possibilities include Nicolas Paz, Rodrigo De Paul, Leandro Paredes, Thiago Almada, Giovani Lo Celso, and Nicolas Gonzalez.
While replacing the shirt number is simple, replacing Messi's influence as the team's greatest creator and prolific scorer will be a far greater challenge for coach Lionel Scaloni.
Argentina has shown it can function without him, notably in a 4-1 victory over Brazil at the Monumental, suggesting the team may spread Messi's responsibilities among several key players.
The next generation, featuring players like Julian Alvarez and Enzo Fernandez, now faces the challenge of carrying the weight once shouldered by one of the greatest players in history.
caption:
The day fans never wanted to arrive is here. Lionel Messi has retired from the Argentina national team.

Lionel Messi has officially announced his retirement from the Argentina national team, ending a legendary international career that saw him lead the Albiceleste to World Cup, Copa America, and Finalissima glory.

A major point of discussion is now the fate of the iconic No. 10 jersey, which Messi first wore on March 28, 2009, in a 4-0 victory over Venezuela under coach Diego Maradona.

Several players have worn the shirt in Messi's absence, including Franco Mastantuono in a recent 2026 World Cup qualifier against Ecuador, as well as Angel Correa and Paulo Dybala.

Potential long-term candidates for the shirt include Lautaro Martinez, who wears No. 10 for Inter, and Alexis Mac Allister, who has worn it for Liverpool.

Other possibilities include Nicolas Paz, Rodrigo De Paul, Leandro Paredes, Thiago Almada, Giovani Lo Celso, and Nicolas Gonzalez.

While replacing the shirt number is simple, replacing Messi's influence as the team's greatest creator and prolific scorer will be a far greater challenge for coach Lionel Scaloni.

Argentina has shown it can function without him, notably in a 4-1 victory over Brazil at the Monumental, suggesting the team may spread Messi's responsibilities among several key players.

The next generation, featuring players like Julian Alvarez and Enzo Fernandez, now faces the challenge of carrying the weight once shouldered by one of the greatest players in history.
